summary: A cleanup callback, if scheduled, runs only after the current synchronous ECMAScript execution has completed.

semantics.not_inline: cleanup is not invoked synchronously by register or by target becoming unreachable

tests.name: register not synchronous cleanup
tests.input: let called=false; const f=new FinalizationRegistry(()=>called=true),x={}; f.register(x,1); console.log(called)

tests.name: callback not called by unregister
tests.input: let called=false; const f=new FinalizationRegistry(()=>called=true),x={},t={}; f.register(x,1,t); f.unregister(t); console.log(called)
